description: Bug fixes and code cleanup — ESM crashes, off-by-one bugs, dead code, and validation gaps

userStories.title: Fix ESM process imports in all tool scripts
userStories.description: tools/content-stats.js, tools/validate-npcs.js, tools/validate-quests.js, and tools/validate-vocabulary.js use process.exit() but are ES modules without importing process. This causes runtime crashes. Add 'import process from "node:process"' to each file.
acceptanceCriteria: Add import process from 'node:process' to tools/content-stats.js
Add import process from 'node:process' to tools/validate-npcs.js
Add import process from 'node:process' to tools/validate-quests.js
Add import process from 'node:process' to tools/validate-vocabulary.js
Remove unused require() call in tools/validate-npcs.js if present
Remove unused createRequire import in tools/validate-vocabulary.js if present
npm run lint passes with no errors in these files
npm run build passes
userStories.notes: CRITICAL — these scripts crash at runtime. Check each file's import section before modifying.

userStories.title: Fix inventory capacity off-by-one bug
userStories.description: In src/store/slices/inventorySlice.js around line 30, the condition 'state.items.length >= 200' prevents using the 200th slot. If max capacity should be 200, change to '> 200'. If max is 199, add a comment documenting the intentional limit.
acceptanceCriteria: Inventory allows exactly 200 items (change >= to >), OR document that 199 is intentional
Add a named constant MAX_INVENTORY_SIZE at top of file instead of magic number
Update any other references to the magic number 200 in the same file
npm run test:run passes
npm run lint passes
userStories.notes: Read the file first to understand the full context of how capacity is checked.

userStories.title: Fix unused parseFloat calls in factionSlice

userStories.title: Add Zod validation to userController update endpoint
userStories.description: In server/src/controllers/userController.js line 42, req.body keys are iterated dynamically. While an 'allowed' list exists, there's no type validation per field. Add Zod schema validation.
acceptanceCriteria: Create updateProfileSchema with Zod in the controller or a shared schemas file
Schema validates: displayName (string, 1-50 chars), avatar (string, optional), language (enum), etc.
Apply validate middleware to the route OR validate in controller before processing
Invalid field types return 400 with descriptive error
npm run test:run passes
npm run lint passes
userStories.notes: Check existing Zod usage patterns in server/src/ before creating new schemas.

userStories.title: Fix array mutation risk in factionSlice selectors
userStories.description: In src/store/slices/factionSlice.js around line 20, .sort() is called on Object.entries() output during selector computation. Use spread to prevent potential mutation issues.
acceptanceCriteria: Change Object.entries(alignment).sort(...) to [...Object.entries(alignment)].sort(...)
Verify selector still returns correct sorted results
npm run test:run passes
npm run lint passes
userStories.notes: Small change. Object.entries returns a new array so this may be technically safe, but the spread makes intent explicit.
